decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ARD/DWL 02-10/ 01.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development must not be converted/sub-divided into smaller residential/business units without prior consent granted by the local planning authority; such proposal shall be subject to separate planning application.

Condition : 5 - A Construction Management Plan (CMP) and Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) shall be submitted for local authority and TfL's approval prior to construction work commencing on site.  This should include details on:-	no construction vehicles shall stop on Bath Road-	No vehicles shall block footway or carriageway of Bath Road.-	No skip or construction materials to be kept on footway or carriageway of Bath Road.
description: Demolition of the existing garage and erection of a single storey side extension, first floor rear extension, rear roof extension, erection of front entrance porch, internal alterations and alterations to the access from the public highway.
